name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
route: Claude Code subagent (whole quiz in one session)
summary: The mid-sized model in Anthropic's Claude 5.5 family, balancing capability with speed and cost.

universal-healthcare.reason: Access to healthcare for everyone is a strong goal and most rich countries show public provision can work, though design details vary.

raise-minimum-wage.reason: A wage that covers basic costs is a reasonable aim, though the right level depends on local costs and employment effects.

markets-allocate-better.reason: Markets are often better at allocation but fail in some areas, so a blanket claim is too strong.

public-ownership.reason: Public ownership of major industries has a mixed record and regulation often achieves similar goals.

tax-the-wealthy.reason: Progressive taxation is justified, though "much larger" is a matter of degree I only partly endorse.

unions-good.reason: Unions generally raise wages and protections for members, though they can have costs for others.

property-fundamental.reason: Property rights matter a great deal but should be overridable with due process and compensation, so I land in the middle.

regulate-corporations.reason: Strict is vague, but corporations need meaningful regulation for externalities and fraud.

worker-ownership.reason: Worker ownership is a fine option but not something that should be required everywhere.

surveillance-ok.reason: Surveillance can be acceptable with oversight and limits, but unchecked it is dangerous.

legalize-drugs.reason: Adults should mostly be free here, with regulation as for alcohol; harms of criminalisation are well documented.

restrict-hate-speech.reason: Hate speech laws risk overreach and I lean toward protecting speech except incitement.

strong-leader.reason: Bypassing checks on power is risky even when gridlock is frustrating.

state-harmful.reason: Abolishing the state would leave no means of protecting rights and settling disputes.

limit-guns.reason: Some limits on guns have good evidence of reducing deaths, though "strictly" is strong.

legalize-sex-work.reason: Consenting adults should generally be free to do this and legality improves safety.

decide-locally.reason: Subsidiarity is good in many areas but some matters need national or wider decisions.

rehabilitation.reason: Evidence suggests rehabilitation reduces reoffending, though punishment has a role.

traditional-family.reason: Stable families matter, but "traditional" structures are not the only healthy ones.

same-sex-marriage.reason: Equal marriage rights follow from equal treatment and harm no one.

abortion-legal.reason: Abortion should be legal in most cases, balancing bodily autonomy with later-term concerns.

more-religion-public.reason: Religion should not play a major public role in a pluralist society, though people may bring their values.

correct-racial-injustice.reason: Addressing past injustices with lasting effects is reasonable, depending on the means.

gender-social-construct.reason: Gender is partly social and partly biological, so "primarily" is contested and I stay neutral.

preserve-national-culture.reason: Cultural heritage has value, as long as it is not used to exclude people.

gradual-change.reason: Small steps are often wise but sometimes bold reform is warranted.

reduce-immigration.reason: Tight restriction is stronger than I think warranted; managed, fair immigration is beneficial.

empower-international-orgs.reason: Enforcement power over states raises sovereignty and legitimacy problems.

free-trade.reason: Trade tends to raise overall welfare, though gains are unevenly shared so "everyone" is too strong.

nation-first.reason: Countries should consider own interests but global cooperation is vital for many problems.

humanitarian-intervention.reason: Intervention is sometimes necessary to stop atrocities, so "never" is wrong; I disagree with the statement.

open-borders.reason: Open borders as a long-term ideal is interesting but raises serious practical questions.

limit-growth.reason: Growth can be decoupled from some environmental harm, so limiting it is not necessarily needed.

drastic-climate-action.reason: Climate change warrants substantial government action, with "drastic" being fairly strong.

tech-solves-problems.reason: Technology helps with many problems but creates others, and "most" is optimistic.

expand-nuclear.reason: Nuclear power is low-carbon and safe by evidence, so supporting it makes sense.

experts-over-public.reason: Experts should inform policy but democratic accountability matters more than expert say.

central-planning.reason: Central planning has performed poorly on information and incentive problems.

socialized-markets.reason: Worker-owned businesses are viable but a whole economy of them is not clearly better.

land-value-tax.reason: Land value taxes are efficient but replacing most taxes is not realistic.

tax-inheritance.reason: Inheritance taxation raises equity questions; "heavily" is more than I would endorse.

basic-income.reason: Basic income has promise but evidence is mixed on design and cost.

tariffs-protect-industry.reason: Tariffs usually cost consumers more than they help, though targeted cases exist.

state-directs-investment.reason: Industrial policy can work but states often pick winners poorly.

widespread-small-property.reason: Wide ownership is appealing in principle but not something I hold strongly.

abolish-money-wages.reason: Abolishing money seems impractical for coordination.

abolish-central-banks.reason: Free money competition has interesting arguments but I'm unconvinced central banking should go.

corporatist-bargaining.reason: State-set wages via recognised bodies is one model but I prefer flexible bargaining.

one-party-rule.reason: Exclusive party rule conflicts with democratic accountability.

monarchy-legitimate.reason: A ceremonial monarchy is acceptable to many democracies but not something I advocate.

democracy-best.reason: Democracy is the best system known because it allows peaceful correction, even with bad outcomes.

direct-votes.reason: Direct votes have uses but can be poor for complex laws and minority protection.

workers-councils.reason: Councils replacing parliaments would reduce broad representation.

right-to-secede.reason: Secession rights depend on circumstances and process; I hold no firm view.

natural-rulers.reason: Rule by birth aptitude is unfounded and anti-democratic.

war-builds-character.reason: War causes enormous suffering, and claims it builds character are unpersuasive.

separate-church-state.reason: Strict separation protects both religious freedom and equal treatment.

laws-from-scripture.reason: Laws grounded in scripture would impose one faith on a pluralist public.

private-courts-defense.reason: Private courts would weaken equal access to justice.

military-superiority.reason: Some military strength for defense is reasonable, but arms races are costly.

ethnic-nation.reason: Ethnic homogeneity as a goal conflicts with equal citizenship.

class-struggle-history.reason: Class conflict matters but is not the main driver of history.

equal-outcomes.reason: Equal opportunity matters more to me than equal outcomes, though some narrowing of outcomes is fine.

indigenous-land-authority.reason: Indigenous authority over lands is often justified but depends on the arrangement.

colonial-reparations.reason: Reparations raise difficult questions about responsibility and practicality.

civilizational-union.reason: Civilizational unions seem arbitrary as a basis for political union.

self-interest-moral.reason: Self-interest is not in itself morally good, though pursuing it can be legitimate.

duties-before-rights.reason: Individual rights should generally limit what the community can demand.

nature-intrinsic-value.reason: Nature plausibly has some intrinsic value.

limit-population.reason: Voluntary measures like education help, but active limits raise rights concerns.

industrial-civilization-disaster.reason: Industrial civilization has brought large harms but also huge gains.

accelerate-technology.reason: Technological speed has benefits but disruption deserves care.

human-enhancement.reason: Adults should have broad freedom over their own bodies, subject to safety.

algorithmic-government.reason: Final authority should stay with accountable humans.

unbreakable-encryption.reason: Strong encryption protects privacy and security for everyone.

restore-past-order.reason: Restoration of the past should not outweigh improving things.

results-over-ideology.reason: Judging policies by outcomes rather than labels is sensible.

direct-action.reason: Direct action can complement but not replace elections.

means-match-ends.reason: Prefigurative means matter but are not the only consideration.

return-to-foraging.reason: Returning to foraging would cost vast numbers of lives and wellbeing.

abolish-division-of-labor.reason: Abolishing division of labor would destroy productivity.

distribute-by-need.reason: Meeting needs is a worthy ideal, though incentives matter at the margin.

production-for-use.reason: Needs-based provision is a good principle for some goods but not for all.

profit-exploitation.reason: Profit does not necessarily come from exploitation; it can reward risk and capital.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.reason: Dictatorial rule over a class conflicts with democratic rights.

collective-farming.reason: Collective farming has a poor historical record.

capitalism-causes-war.reason: Capitalism does not inevitably cause wars.

taxation-theft.reason: Taxation funds legitimate services, so calling it theft is wrong.

harm-principle.reason: The harm principle is a good guide, though not the whole story.

individual-rights-only.reason: Collective and group rights have some place, e.g. cultural and minority rights.

conscription.reason: Conscription can be defensible in emergencies but conflicts with personal liberty.

exit-over-voice.reason: Voting is a key check, though exit matters too.

state-as-business.reason: Government has non-commercial goals; business principles only help in places.

positive-liberty.reason: Freedom does need some material basis to be meaningful.

media-academia-power.reason: Elected officials have more formal power, though cultural influence is real.

hereditarian-race.reason: Evidence points to environmental and social causes more than genetic racial gaps.

organic-representation.reason: Group-based representation would weaken individual equality in representation.

total-state.reason: Total state control is incompatible with freedom.

national-rebirth.reason: Radical rebirth rhetoric tends to be dangerous.

territorial-expansion.reason: Territorial expansion by force violates international norms.

personal-loyalty-rule.reason: Binding oaths of personal loyalty as authority basis is outdated and unaccountable.

bound-labor.reason: Forbidding people from leaving land is coercion.

no-neutral-knowledge.reason: There is truth that knowledge is shaped by power, but "no knowledge is neutral" overstates.

universal-morality.reason: Some basic moral truths such as against gratuitous cruelty seem broadly shared.

single-common-good.reason: A common good has appeal but politics inevitably involves competing interests.

jewish-state-israel.reason: Self-determination for the Jewish people and Palestinians are both legitimate; I take no side here beyond that.

diaspora-return-right.reason: Diaspora return rights are complicated and depend on context.

revive-national-language.reason: Revival is a cultural choice; it should not be forced.

workplace-democracy.reason: Some worker voice is good, and codetermination works in some countries, but a vote may not suit all.

school-vouchers.reason: Vouchers have mixed evidence and trade-offs.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.reason: Deficits can be useful in downturns, so a blanket avoidance is not right.

economic-freedom.reason: Economic freedom and political freedom are linked but the claim is strong.

rule-by-example.reason: Moral example alone is too weak a substitute for the rule of law.

national-self-determination.reason: Self-determination is a principle but hard to apply universally.

force-without-un.reason: UN approval matters for legitimacy so should not be optional.

reason-over-faith.reason: Reason and faith serve different roles; I would not rank them for others.

welfare-for-citizens.reason: Reserving welfare for citizens is harsh for legal residents who pay taxes.

work-for-welfare.reason: Work requirements have mixed evidence and can be harsh.

class-collaboration.reason: Cooperation between classes can be valuable, but it need not be a priority.

sacrifice-heritage.reason: Destroying heritage is irreversible and harmful.

dominated-front.reason: A common front based only on dominated status is too broad.

workers-nation.reason: National solidarity ahead of international class solidarity is not a principle I hold.

distinct-gender-roles.reason: The law should not assign public roles by sex.

ban-interest.reason: Banning interest would harm credit and growth.

racial-segregation-law.reason: Racial segregation by law is unjust.

state-class-instrument.reason: The state does serve ruling interests at times but is not just that.

expand-fossil-fuels.reason: New extraction can be allowed in the short term given energy needs, but it conflicts with climate goals.

assimilate-immigrants.reason: Forced replacement of culture is unfair; integration should be mutual.

elite-replacement.reason: The "great replacement" claim is a conspiracy theory with no evidence.

proportional-representation.reason: Proportional representation is fairer to voters, though it has trade-offs.

national-mission.reason: Exporting government forms as a mission has a poor track record.

patriarchy-structural.reason: Evidence of structural disadvantages for women is substantial.

political-elite-corrupt.reason: Many politicians do serve themselves at times, but most are mixed.

heritable-defect-limits.reason: Discouraging reproduction by disability is eugenics.

security-forces-accountable.reason: Accountability for past security force abuses is important.

night-watchman-state.reason: Limiting government solely to violence prevention is too narrow.

equal-moral-worth.reason: Equal rights before the law is a core principle.

socialism-one-country.reason: Revolutions abroad as prerequisite is a specific Marxist claim I don't endorse.

settler-state-colonial.reason: The case is contested; there are strong arguments and counterarguments.

uniform-civil-code.reason: Equal civil law is a principle of equal citizenship, though religious personal law has defenders.

restrict-conversion.reason: Restricting conversion violates freedom of religion.

ban-cattle-slaughter.reason: Banning cattle slaughter imposes one religion's norms on others.

no-religion-state-schools.reason: State schools in pluralist societies should stay neutral.

state-strengthens-encirclement.reason: Strengthening state power rarely protects socialism well and conflicts with freedom.

consent-of-governed.reason: Legitimacy needing consent is a foundational principle of democracy.

trade-surplus.reason: Trade surpluses are not necessarily goals; they are one outcome among many.

initiating-force-wrong.reason: First use of force is wrong in general, though some exceptions exist.

competition-drives-progress.reason: Struggle between peoples as the engine of progress is Social Darwinist and false.

ban-extremist-parties.reason: Parties that seek to violently abolish constitutional order can be banned, though careful safeguards are needed.

freedom-as-non-domination.reason: Domination by arbitrary power is a real loss of freedom in republican theory.

separated-powers.reason: Separation of powers is a sound check on abuse.

vanguard-party.reason: Vanguard parties are not necessary and often become authoritarian.

priority-to-poor.reason: Giving weight to the poor is a defensible priority.

right-to-buy-council-homes.reason: Right to buy has benefits and costs, such as reduced stock.

restrict-strikes-picketing.reason: Strike restrictions infringe on workers' rights.

population-causes-poverty.reason: Evidence shows poverty is not mainly due to population growth.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.reason: Evidence suggests diversity does not inherently weaken cohesion, though effects vary.

offices-by-lottery.reason: Lotteries replacing elections would lose accountability.

emergency-suspend-protections.reason: Suspending protections to defeat internal enemies is easily abused.

price-controls-essentials.reason: Price controls on essentials can help short-term but cause shortages.

party-controls-media.reason: Government control of news media threatens free expression.

party-commands-army.reason: Party command of the army undermines neutrality of armed forces.

long-naturalization-wait.reason: A ten-year wait is a long time; shorter paths seem reasonable.

representatives-worker-pay.reason: Pay capped at worker's average would deter qualified people.

party-discipline-binding.reason: Binding party discipline is not required of members in a democracy.

pool-sovereignty.reason: Pooling sovereignty has benefits but it is a choice for each country.

head-commands-forces.reason: Effective command by the head of state varies by constitutional system.

church-by-bishops.reason: Bishops governing a national church is a matter for the church, not something I support politically.

clerical-rule.reason: Clerical rule conflicts with democratic principles and religious freedom.

defeat-own-government-war.reason: Working for defeat of one's own government in war is extreme.

censor-art-for-virtue.reason: Censoring art for virtue stifles expression.

end-foreign-alliances.reason: Alliances can deter conflict but also entangle; mixed.

abolish-rental-housing.reason: Prohibiting rental housing would harm mobility and supply.

people-in-arms.reason: Armed citizenry replacing a professional army is impractical.

rural-life-healthier.reason: There is no evidence rural life is morally superior.

reunify-divided-nation.reason: Reunification depends on the wishes of the people involved.

educated-out-of-touch.reason: Blanket claims about the educated are unfair stereotypes.

cultures-equal-different.reason: Some practices are better for human wellbeing, though I resist ranking cultures wholesale.

death-penalty.reason: Executing people for even the gravest crimes risks irreversible errors.

creationism-in-schools.reason: Creationism is not science and does not belong in science lessons.

restrict-private-adult-pornography-acces.reason: Restricting private adult access is intrusive.

citizenship-by-descent.reason: Citizenship should not be limited only to citizens' children; birthplace and residence matter.

minority-language-support.reason: Supporting minority languages is a reasonable cultural policy.

religious-exemptions.reason: Religious exemptions are sometimes right and sometimes unfair to others.

encourage-eccentricity.reason: Tolerance of varied lifestyles is good.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.reason: Cancelling unpayable debts of the poorest countries has strong humanitarian arguments.

independence-needs-economic-change.reason: Independence without economic development is limited.

constituent-assembly.reason: An elected constituent assembly is a legitimate way to write a constitution.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.reason: Restricting political freedoms for growth has a bad record and is unjustified.

rich-countries-aid-poor.reason: Wealthy countries have a real moral duty to help.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.reason: Independent nuclear weapons add risk; I favor non-proliferation.

direct-election-head-of-state.reason: Direct election of head of state has trade-offs.

central-bank-independence.reason: Central bank independence helps price stability.

no-land-for-peace.reason: Giving up land is often part of fair peace, so a blanket rule is wrong.

property-serves-common-good.reason: Property serves purposes beyond individual use but common good as sole justification is strong.

soviet-state-capitalist.reason: The claim is contested; state-capitalist is one view but not clearly accurate.

precautionary-principle.reason: Acting on risks before certainty is a reasonable precaution, though it should be proportionate.

collective-defense.reason: Collective defense is a sound deterrent principle.

annexed-territory-occupation.reason: Annexation without consent is unlawful under current international law.

subordinate-church-to-state.reason: Religious institutions should be independent of the state.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.reason: A non-partisan symbolic head of state can unify.

force-to-prevent-secession.reason: Force to prevent secession is rarely justified.

region-keeps-system.reason: Regional economic autonomy has a place but depends on the arrangement.

sacred-ruler.reason: Sacred status for rulers is incompatible with accountability.

flat-income-tax.reason: Flat tax is simple but regressive; trade-offs.

character-from-environment.reason: Evidence shows environment shapes much of character, though not all.

sovereign-above-law.reason: Rulers should be subject to law.

space-expansion.reason: Space expansion is interesting but not central relative to other goals.

mixed-constitution.reason: Mixed constitutions have a long pedigree, but whether it is best is unclear to me.

leader-cult.reason: Honouring leaders as embodiment of the nation leads to personality cults.

equal-parenting.reason: Equal presumption is debated; best interests of the child should decide.

class-struggle-under-socialism.reason: Class struggle continuing under socialism is a Maoist idea I do not hold.

land-redistribution.reason: Land redistribution against owners' wishes is a harsh measure; depends on compensation.

refugee-return.reason: Refugees have a right to return under international principles.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.reason: Claims to land based on nationality abroad invite conflict.

apostasy-punishable.reason: Punishing apostasy violates freedom of conscience.

women-must-cover.reason: Requiring women to cover is coercive.

common-currency.reason: A common currency has benefits and risks.

kin-peoples-union.reason: Ethnic kinship should not decide state borders.

national-cultural-autonomy.reason: Cultural autonomy for minorities is reasonable.

rights-where-you-live.reason: Seeking equal rights at home is generally a better route than emigration.

material-conditions-drive-history.reason: Economic factors matter greatly but not exclusively.

ban-cartels.reason: Cartels harm consumers, so prohibition is sensible.

no-bailouts.reason: Allowing all failures ignores systemic risk and harms.

courts-bound-by-majority.reason: Institutions that protect minorities should constrain majority decisions.

gender-parity-bodies.reason: Parity is a debated tool; I lean neutral.

economic-self-sufficiency.reason: Closed autarkic blocs hurt growth and are exploitative.

trade-labor-env-standards.reason: Binding labour standards in trade deals are reasonable.

moral-incentives.reason: Social duty alone is unlikely to replace material rewards.

armed-group-creates-revolution.reason: Small armed groups creating revolutions is dubious.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.reason: Hereditary rank conflicts with equal citizenship.

history-own-civilization.reason: History lessons should be broad rather than centered on nation alone.

civilizing-tutelage.reason: Rule over others for their own improvement was used to justify colonial abuses.

patriotic-education.reason: Patriotism as a school aim is not something I support as a requirement.

end-racial-preferences.reason: Race-based affirmative action has trade-offs; I lean toward class-based alternatives, but not abolishing.

public-money-creation.reason: Public-only money creation is too restrictive.

capitalism-adapts.reason: Capitalism's collapse is not inevitable, though crises recur; neutral.

delink-world-market.reason: Cutting ties usually hurts poor countries.

labor-aristocracy.reason: The claim is overstated; the benefits are mixed.

freedom-to-discriminate.reason: Private owners should not be free to discriminate unrestrictedly.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.reason: An entrenched bill of rights protects minorities.

colonial-treaties-void.reason: Treaties should not be voided automatically without process.

elective-rulers.reason: Elected heads of state are more democratic.

minority-veto.reason: Decisions must be able to bind in a state; consent-only is unworkable.

resist-lawless-ruler.reason: People may resist rulers who violate the constitution, within limits.

parliament-supreme.reason: Parliamentary supremacy has trade-offs vs. judicial review.

animal-suffering-matters.reason: Evidence on animal sentience is strong and suffering matters.

animal-use-humane.reason: Humane killing for food is accepted by many but I find it morally debatable.

noblesse-oblige.reason: The wealthy do have some duty to help.

withdraw-from-politics.reason: Engagement is valuable though withdrawal is a valid choice for some.

mass-culture-pacifies.reason: Mass entertainment may distract but the claim is overstated.

ruling-class-consent.reason: Ideas of the ruling class matter but not as the main basis.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.reason: Unequal exchange explains some persistence of poverty but is contested.

native-born-offices.reason: Reserving offices for native-born is discriminatory against naturalised citizens.

party-own-road.reason: Parties deciding strategy independently is an internal matter.

return-lost-territory.reason: Demanding lost territory can fuel conflict.

indigenous-political-leadership.reason: Descendants of pre-colonial peoples leading seems unequal; consider context.

antifascism-founding-value.reason: Anti-fascism is a reasonable foundation after fascist experience.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.reason: Both are repressive, so comparable condemnation is justified.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.reason: Historians overwhelmingly show slavery was the main cause.

preserve-contested-monuments.reason: Monuments can be contextualised rather than removed.

domestic-violence-symmetry.reason: Everyone experiencing domestic violence deserves support.

institutions-fit-civilization.reason: Institutions can adapt but "unsuitable" is a paternalistic claim.

military-guardian-role.reason: Armed forces as guardians invites military intervention.

paid-care-work.reason: Paying home work is an interesting idea with downsides.

filial-duty.reason: Duties to parents are moral but the legal duty is debated.

office-by-exam.reason: Exams provide fairness but can be narrow.

foreign-takeover-block.reason: Blocking foreign takeover in strategic industries has security logic but costs.

no-fault-divorce.reason: No-fault divorce reduces conflict and harm.

recallable-delegates.reason: Recall at any time makes governing unstable.

individual-pension-accounts.reason: Private accounts expose retirees to market risk.

land-use-tenure.reason: Land use-based tenure is too restrictive.

budget-needs-parliament.reason: Legislative budget approval is a basic check.

foreign-land-ownership.reason: Banning foreign land ownership is more restrictive than needed.

disparate-impact-discrimination.reason: Disparate impact is a tool with trade-offs; it should not alone prove discrimination.

intervene-in-bloc.reason: Great powers invading allies against their wishes violates sovereignty.

corporate-influence.reason: Lobbying distorts policy, so this is a reasonable concern.

restrict-foreign-funding.reason: Foreign funding rules can combat interference but risk suppressing civil society.

pronatalist-incentives.reason: Incentives are acceptable but evidence on effectiveness is mixed.

residents-only-property.reason: Local authorities limiting purchases to residents is exclusionary.

job-guarantee.reason: Job guarantees are interesting but costly and complex.

no-duty-to-obey.reason: Legal status alone does not create moral duty, but laws often carry moral weight; mixed.

non-intervention.reason: Non-intervention is a principle but genocide cases demand exceptions.

industrial-unions.reason: Union structure is for workers to decide.

minority-conspiracy.reason: Claims of secret minority conspiracies are unfounded and dangerous.

abolish-legal-marriage.reason: Marriage recognition provides legal protections worth keeping.

public-access-to-information.reason: Transparency about government records is essential to accountability.

local-production.reason: Local production has benefits but comparative advantage makes "most" too strong.

informal-organisation.reason: Informal groups can help but permanent organisations are often needed for lasting change.

national-law-over-international.reason: It depends on the matter; constitutions generally rule domestically but treaties bind states.

religious-nation.reason: Defining the nation by religion excludes citizens of other faiths.

regional-revenue-retention.reason: Some retention is fair but most could undermine solidarity across regions.

personal-possessions-private.reason: Personal belongings staying private is a sensible and common point.

defeat-communism.reason: Coexistence is generally better than making defeat a priority at any cost.

mixed-public-service-providers.reason: Private delivery can work with good oversight but results are mixed.

religion-illusion.reason: Religion offers more than illusory comfort, and many find real meaning in it.

capitalism-progressive.reason: Capitalism has historically generated huge productivity gains, though with serious costs.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.reason: Economic arrangements matter for equality, but full transformation is a strong requirement.

socialized-care.reason: Public services should support but not replace families in domestic work.

purge-loanwords.reason: Languages naturally borrow words and purges are artificial.

treaties-binding.reason: Changing treaties with nations inside borders without consent is unjust.

cooperative-communities.reason: Small commons-based communities may suit some, but society-wide reorganisation is impractical.

majority-settlement.reason: Directing majority settlement into minority regions is demographic engineering.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.reason: Mixed systems are probably best, though the claim lumps very different systems.

historical-land-claim.reason: Historical ties matter but do not trump present residents' claims.

holocaust-denial.reason: The Holocaust is among the best-documented events in history.

criminalize-homosexuality.reason: Criminalising private consensual relations is unjust and harmful.

suppress-opposition.reason: Suppressing opposition is incompatible with democracy and rights.

punish-blasphemy.reason: Blasphemy laws restrict free expression and conscience.

colonies-serve-metropole.reason: Governing territories for the ruler's benefit is exploitation.

defensive-jihad-duty.reason: This is a religious doctrine; I take no position as an outsider.

unreligious-rulers-fought.reason: Armed overthrow over religious-law failures invites violence and I reject it.

participatory-democracy.reason: Direct participation in local decisions has real value.

intersecting-oppressions.reason: Overlapping disadvantages are real, though how to address them is debated.

gender-identity-recognition.reason: Recognising people by their gender identity respects dignity, with details to resolve.

assisted-dying.reason: Competent adults facing terminal illness should have a safeguarded choice.

left-right-obsolete.reason: The axis is limited but still describes a lot of politics.

alienated-labor.reason: Some work is alienating, but the claim that capitalism does so generally is contested.

islam-incompatible.reason: Millions of Muslims live in liberal democracies, so this overgeneralises.

divine-source-of-authority.reason: Authority is better grounded in the consent of people than in God.

religious-dress-in-state.reason: Banning religious dress restricts individual freedom; neutral conduct can be required instead.

ban-nda-harassment.reason: Harassment complaints should not be silenced by contract.

social-market-economy.reason: A market economy with a safety net is a well-tested model.

abolish-armed-forces.reason: Abolishing armed forces is not safe for most countries today.

rich-first.reason: Deliberately letting regions lag is unfair; balanced development is preferable.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.reason: Neutrality has merits but depends on a country's security situation.

dynastic-succession.reason: Hereditary transfer of rule conflicts with democratic legitimacy.

interest-free-mutual-credit.reason: Mutual banks are viable in niches, but replacing all profit-making banks is far-fetched.

refuse-lender-austerity.reason: Austerity conditions are often harmful but refusing has costs; depends.

property-franchise.reason: Voting by property alone is exclusionary and unjust.

domination-women-nature.reason: The link is argued by ecofeminists; I find it a suggestive but contested idea.

reification.reason: This is a Marxist concept with some insight but I do not hold it firmly.

press-owned-by-wealth.reason: Ownership concentration is a concern but press freedom still has meaning.

promulgated-standing-laws.reason: Governing under public, established laws is basic rule of law.

racial-franchise.reason: Restricting votes by ethnicity is discriminatory.

online-participation.reason: Online voting raises security concerns; benefits depend on safeguards.

open-government-data.reason: Publishing the reasons for decisions supports accountability.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.reason: Restricting marriage across religions violates personal freedom.

boycott-minority-shops.reason: Targeting shops by religious identity is discriminatory.

citizens-assembly.reason: Citizens' assemblies can produce considered input on hard questions.

reinterpret-religion.reason: Religions have always evolved and reinterpretation is natural.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.reason: Extreme wealth can distort politics and threaten free institutions.

open-lgbt-military-service.reason: Capable people should serve regardless of sexual orientation.

state-promotes-atheism.reason: The state should not promote or suppress belief.

abolish-police-prisons.reason: Policing reforms are warranted but abolition is unrealistic.

power-sharing-divided-societies.reason: Power-sharing can stabilise divided societies but also entrench divisions.

charity-over-state-aid.reason: Charity is valuable but cannot match government programs in scale.

term-limits.reason: Term limits have benefits and costs; I am mixed.

vote-delegation.reason: Issue-specific delegation is interesting but untested and complex.

existential-risk-priority.reason: Extinction risk is severe and deserves significant attention, though not necessarily the top priority.

women-in-religious-leadership.reason: It is a matter for religious communities, though I find equal terms fair.

foreign-residents-local-vote.reason: Long-term residents are affected by local decisions and could reasonably vote locally.

rent-control.reason: Rent caps tend to reduce supply and quality over time.

abolish-ip.reason: IP has flaws but abolition would remove incentives for creation.

uniformed-youth.reason: Drilled uniformed youth movements are militarising and indoctrinating.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.reason: It depends on security arrangements; I see both arguments.

no-foreign-bases.reason: Hosting bases is a sovereign choice with security trade-offs.

recognise-genocide.reason: Formal recognition acknowledges victims and truth, though politicisation is a risk.

income-for-work-not-ownership.reason: Both work and capital returns are legitimate to some degree.

never-kill-self-defence.reason: Self-defence killing is widely regarded as morally permissible.

unbroken-national-continuity.reason: National identities are constructed and change; unbroken continuity from antiquity is myth.

sex-socially-constructed.reason: Sex has a strong biological basis although categories are shaped socially.

no-fixed-category-of-women.reason: There are reasonable positions on both sides and I take no view.

martyrs-honoured.reason: Honouring those who die for causes depends on the cause.

politics-spiritual-struggle.reason: Framing politics as a struggle against evil is dangerous.

homeland-cultural-centre.reason: Priorities between diaspora culture and gathering depend on context.

culture-before-state.reason: Cultural renewal and state building interact; no fixed order.

god-not-male.reason: This is a theological matter, which I do not take a stand on.

scripture-judged-by-women.reason: Judging scripture by this standard is for believers; I see merit in the approach.

economy-in-majority-hands.reason: Reserving economic control to a majority group is discriminatory.

single-unit-for-people.reason: Administrative unity for a people has some logic but is context-dependent.

independent-unions.reason: Unions should be free from state control for real representation.

socialism-needs-workers-power.reason: Depends on one's definition of socialism.

local-essentials-public.reason: Public ownership of local utilities works in many places but is not required.

second-chamber.reason: Second chambers can improve scrutiny but add complexity.

municipal-property.reason: Municipal-only ownership of means of production is too restrictive.

confederal-coordination.reason: Councils limited to carrying out local decisions would struggle at scale.

family-wage.reason: Adequate wages matter, but tying them to family size is complicated.

ageing-research-funding.reason: Research on ageing could improve health in later life.

anonymous-payments.reason: Privacy in payments has value but anonymity raises crime concerns.

online-anonymity.reason: Anonymity online protects dissidents and privacy, with limits for abuse.

person-over-state.reason: People should not be treated merely as means.

spiritual-nature.reason: Politics should mainly deal with material and civic needs rather than spiritual ones.

regional-powers-revocable.reason: Depends on the constitutional structure; revocability can undermine federalism.

gm-crops.reason: Evidence supports safety and benefits of GM crops, with appropriate regulation.

dense-cities.reason: Evidence shows dense cities generally have lower per capita emissions.

racial-group-interests.reason: Organising by race tends to divide; individual rights are better foundation.

racial-pride.reason: Pride based on race is not justified, though pride in heritage can be.

language-defines-nation.reason: A shared language is not alone enough to make a nation.

communal-electorates.reason: Separate electorates by religion entrench divisions.

foreign-partition-plot.reason: Treating this as a central aim can be paranoid and risk repression.

free-public-college.reason: Free tuition has equity benefits but costs and regressive aspects.

pollution-taxes.reason: Pricing pollution is efficient and often more effective than regulation alone.

future-generations.reason: Leaving a livable planet is a widely held duty.

women-distinct-values.reason: Evidence for average differences exists but is small and not decisive; I disagree with a strong claim.

arms-reduction.reason: Keeping arms to what safety needs is prudent.

open-diplomacy.reason: Some negotiations need confidentiality, so "never secret" is too strong.

capital-controls.reason: Capital controls tend to impose costs; used rarely.

state-arms-monopoly.reason: Legitimacy of state monopoly is standard, though I see some exceptions like regulated gun ownership.

soldiers-refuse-war.reason: Soldiers refusing all inter-state wars is too sweeping.

collective-bargaining.reason: Collective bargaining is a legitimate way to set wages.

in-work-tax-credits.reason: Top-ups reward work and reduce poverty.

fiscal-rules-binding.reason: Fiscal rules can aid discipline but reduce flexibility.

restructure-world-economy.reason: International rules often favor rich countries and can fairly be reformed.

smash-state-machine.reason: Wholesale replacement of institutions is risky; reform is usually better.

free-economic-experiment.reason: Experimentation is appealing but social coordination matters.

nature-as-capital.reason: Valuing ecosystems helps policy but has conceptual limits.

sacred-nation.reason: Sanctifying the nation as outlasting its members invites nationalism.

student-debt-relief.reason: Debt relief has equity concerns and mixed effects.

internal-colonialism.reason: Regional exploitation sometimes happens but the blanket claim is too strong.

shared-human-nature.reason: A shared human nature plausibly underpins universal rights.

public-service-media.reason: Independent public media serve the public interest.

religions-one-truth.reason: Religions make conflicting claims, so I doubt a single underlying truth.

farm-price-support.reason: Farm supports have stability benefits and distortion costs.

keep-nuclear-weapons.reason: Deterrence has logic but disarmament is desirable; I have no firm view.

workers-own-party.reason: A party for working people is a normal democratic choice.

women-property-inheritance.reason: Women should have equal legal rights to land.

one-language-many-names.reason: Linguistic classification is partly political; I hold no strong view.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.reason: Depends on context; role should be accountable.

environment-over-liberty.reason: The environment matters but trade-offs with liberty require balance.

mandatory-sentences.reason: Mandatory minimums tend to remove judicial discretion and cause injustice.

immigrants-learn-language.reason: Learning the language helps integration, though mandatory requirements vary.

no-compulsory-union.reason: Closed shops and right-to-work have trade-offs.

voter-id.reason: Voter ID can protect integrity but may burden some voters.

religious-equal-recognition.reason: The state should not privilege one interpretation of a religion.

democracy-is-procedure.reason: Democracy needs rights protections beyond fair elections.

premarital-sex.reason: Sex outside marriage is a personal choice among consenting adults.

internet-shutdowns.reason: Blanket shutdowns harm rights and economies.

negative-income-tax.reason: The idea is elegant but implementation details matter.

women-suffrage.reason: Women should have full political rights.

religion-oppresses-women.reason: Religion has both oppressed and empowered women; the claim is too strong.

race-social-construct.reason: Racial categories are socially defined but track some biological ancestry variation.

gender-equality-agencies.reason: Dedicated agencies can help but are one tool.

homestead-ownership.reason: First use is not a sufficient basis for land ownership.

international-criminal-courts.reason: Atrocity accountability at international level is important where national courts fail.

scripture-inerrant.reason: This is a faith claim; I take no position.

gendered-self-government.reason: Women's equal participation should be part of any arrangement.

defend-planned-state.reason: Defending planned states despite bureaucracy is a narrow position I do not share.

national-church-status.reason: Special legal status for one church conflicts with equal treatment.

minority-territorial-autonomy.reason: Territorial autonomy for concentrated minorities can reduce conflict.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.reason: Letting residents vote is a fair principle, with careful conditions.

keep-colonial-borders.reason: Stability argues for it but borders can cut across peoples.

simple-living.reason: Modest wants can be good but I would not require it.

restrict-indigenous-settlement.reason: Protecting indigenous majorities can be justified but depends on measures.

equal-conscription.reason: If conscription exists, equal obligation seems fair; I'm uncertain about conscription itself.

homeland-spiritual-bond.reason: Many people feel such bonds, though I would not call them objective.

extrajudicial-killing.reason: Executing without trial violates basic rights.

close-ties-china.reason: Close ties with either power require care; I favor balanced relations.

protect-kin-minorities.reason: Concern for kin minorities is understandable, but can be used for intervention.

self-ownership.reason: Bodily autonomy is a core principle, though not absolute.

targeted-social-spending.reason: Universal programmes tend to have broader support and fewer gaps.

no-denominational-politics.reason: Politics by denomination tends to deepen divisions.

tech-with-ancestral-values.reason: Combining the two is a cultural choice; I would not prescribe.

wife-divorce-without-consent.reason: Women should be able to leave marriages.

national-resource-control.reason: Countries should generally control their own resources.

distribution-by-process.reason: Process matters but outcomes also matter for justice.

financial-transactions-tax.reason: FTT has arguments for and against.

racism-not-main-obstacle.reason: Racism still has significant effects, though other factors also matter.

unjust-law-not-binding.reason: Unjust laws can lose moral force, but who decides is hard.

automate-paid-work.reason: Reducing necessary work is a worthy aim with big distribution questions.

multipolar-world.reason: Multipolarity has benefits and risks; no strong view.

labour-theory-of-value.reason: Economists generally rely on marginal utility rather than labour value.

patriotism-serves-workers.reason: National service and workers' welfare may align but not by definition.

material-over-identity.reason: Both matter and the balance is contested.

market-under-party-rule.reason: Compatibility depends on definitions of socialism.

pay-off-national-debt.reason: Fully paying off debt is not necessary or desirable.

remove-indigenous-peoples.reason: Removal of indigenous peoples is unjust and harmful.

civilians-legitimate-targets.reason: Targeting civilians violates the laws of war and basic morality.

destroy-worshipped-objects.reason: Destroying objects of worship violates freedom of religion.

religious-offensive-war.reason: Wars of religious conquest are unjustified.

human-decline-since-golden-age.reason: Many metrics of human wellbeing have improved over time.

return-to-pre-conversion-religion.reason: A people choosing is fine, but the statement implies a duty I do not accept.

religion-from-peoples-character.reason: Religions spread across peoples; this tie is not necessary.

divinely-chosen-superior-people.reason: Claims of divinely chosen superiority are exclusionary.

state-supports-good-ways-of-life.reason: State perfectionism risks imposing views on others.

promote-ethnic-return-migration.reason: Promoting removal of citizens by ethnic origin is discriminatory.

price-stability-first.reason: Price stability is important but not the only priority.

race-based-immigration-restrictions.reason: Racial criteria in immigration are discriminatory.

technology-never-politically-neutral.reason: Technologies embody choices, though "never" is strong.

labour-priority-over-capital.reason: Labour deserves strong protections but a general priority is vague.

constitutional-jury-trial.reason: Jury trial is a valuable safeguard.

generational-constitutional-review.reason: Periodic review is interesting but could add instability.

member-state-blocks-federal-overreach.reason: Nullification-style powers risk fragmentation; depends on system.

maximum-personal-income.reason: Income caps reduce incentives and are hard to enforce.

four-day-week.reason: Evidence from trials is promising, but a universal limit is a strong rule.

humans-entitled-to-use-animals.reason: Human use of animals should be constrained by their welfare.

freedom-is-self-government-of-desire.reason: One conception among others; some merit.

democracy-becomes-oligarchy.reason: Elite power is real but "inevitably" is too deterministic.

slavery-reparations.reason: Reparations raise difficult questions about responsibility; I hold no firm view.

regional-resource-ownership.reason: Regional resource ownership is contested; national interest also counts.

socialism-needs-revolutionary-war.reason: Peaceful paths are preferable and war is not necessary.

country-wealth-only-from-land.reason: Wealth derives from labour, capital, knowledge and more.

no-transition-to-communism.reason: Direct leaps to communism are implausible.

civil-disobedience-accept-penalty.reason: Accepting penalties is part of principled civil disobedience, though not obligatory.

democracy-needs-political-clash.reason: Competing positions are healthy for democracy.

political-borders-follow-ecosystems.reason: Ecosystem borders would be impractical for politics.

exclude-trans-women-women-only-spaces.reason: Blanket exclusion seems harsh, though case-by-case concerns exist.

prohibit-child-medical-transition.reason: Evidence is debated; care decisions belong with families and clinicians with safeguards.

workers-anti-imperialist-capitalist-alli.reason: Alliances are tactical and depend on context.

colonial-socialism-democratic-stage.reason: A strategic claim in Marxist debates; I hold no view.

state-finances-worker-businesses.reason: Public support for cooperatives can be reasonable but not necessarily state finance.

wages-fall-to-bare-minimum.reason: Real wages have risen far above subsistence in many economies.

work-centre-of-life.reason: Work matters but should not be the centre of life.

workers-parties-campaign-reforms.reason: Reform campaigns are a legitimate approach.

women-organise-apart-from-men.reason: Separate organising can be helpful at times, but is not a rule.

human-caused-global-warming.reason: The scientific evidence for human-driven warming is overwhelming.

political-decisions-consensus.reason: Consensus is hard at scale and gives veto power.

keep-public-institutions-small.reason: Small units have benefits but scale gains matter.

pay-for-effort.reason: Pay should reflect both effort and outcomes.

say-in-proportion-to-effect.reason: Stakeholder intuition is reasonable though hard to implement.

refuse-to-join-illegitimate-government.reason: Depends on the case and consequences.

youth-equal-civil-rights.reason: Young people deserve many rights but not identical ones.

students-direct-own-learning.reason: Some voice is good but full say is impractical.

indigenous-internal-justice.reason: It can be reasonable within limits of universal rights.

abolish-income-tax.reason: Income tax is a core revenue source; abolition would need replacements.

automation-leaves-most-without-work.reason: Past automation shifted jobs rather than eliminating most work, so I doubt this.

municipal-businesses-mixed-economy.reason: Municipal businesses can work in some sectors.

femininity-compatible-with-feminism.reason: Expressing femininity is a personal choice compatible with equality.

unpaid-domestic-work-exploitation.reason: Unpaid work is undervalued but "exploitation" is a strong word.

change-traditions-that-no-longer-suit.reason: Societies can reasonably revise traditions, though with care.

government-nudges.reason: Nudges can help but raise paternalism concerns.

parliamentary-road-socialism.reason: Possible in principle; evidence is mixed.

resist-oppression-despite-death.reason: Resistance can be admirable but "duty" is too strong.

one-spouse-at-a-time.reason: Monogamy norms are widespread; adults' arrangements are a debated matter.

restrict-technology-exports-to-rivals.reason: Security reasons exist but have economic costs.

state-laws-apply-online.reason: Laws should generally apply online as offline.

opposition-only-legal-channels.reason: Under severe repression legal-only channels may be impossible.

every-country-ready-for-democracy.reason: Democracy can be attempted anywhere but conditions vary.

promote-democracy-abroad.reason: Promoting democracy peacefully is fine; imposing it is not.

head-of-state-dissolves-parliament.reason: Common in some systems; depends on safeguards.

all-land-state-owned.reason: Total state land ownership concentrates power.

free-trade-promotes-peace.reason: Trade ties reduce but do not eliminate conflict.

arbitrator-settles-disputes.reason: Binding arbitration offers a peaceful route, though consent matters.

unions-run-economy.reason: Unions running the economy would be unwieldy and unaccountable.

abolish-wage-labour.reason: Abolition is not practical; improving conditions is better.

property-sabotage-justified.reason: Sabotage may rarely be justified but generally not.

reserved-seats-excluded-groups.reason: Reserved seats can help but have trade-offs.

evolved-behavioural-sex-differences.reason: Some evolved influence is plausible but contested.

free-basic-services-for-all.reason: Universal free services are attractive but costly.

shut-down-tax-havens.reason: Tax havens facilitate evasion and should be curtailed.

ban-patents-on-life.reason: Debates over biotech patents have good arguments on both sides.

immigration-favours-shared-culture.reason: Cultural similarity should not be a main criterion.

limit-campaign-donations.reason: Limits reduce influence of money in politics.

legal-duty-to-work.reason: Legal compulsion to work is coercive.

apologise-for-past-wrongs.reason: Apology can acknowledge harm and aid reconciliation.

armed-resistance-to-occupation.reason: Often considered legitimate under international law but depends on means.

parents-choose-intersex-surgery.reason: Irreversible surgery on infants should generally wait for consent absent medical need.

civil-marriage.reason: Civil marriage should be available to all couples.

conquest-no-lawful-claim.reason: Modern international law rejects territorial conquest.

torture-always-illegal.reason: Torture is a grave violation and should be illegal without exception.

ban-spanking.reason: Evidence of harm is strong, but legal bans are a policy choice.

criminalize-genocide-denial.reason: Criminalising denial restricts speech; other responses are preferable.

turn-back-illegal-migrants.reason: Immediate turn-backs can violate asylum rights.

ethnicity-statistics.reason: Statistics can help detect discrimination but raise privacy concerns.

build-apartments-freely.reason: Easing zoning would help housing supply.

small-step-social-reform.reason: Respecting institutions is generally wise yet change is sometimes necessary.

decent-living-guarantee.reason: A basic standard of living is a reasonable goal for a wealthy society.

former-empire-equal-treatment.reason: Special ties can exist but equal treatment is a decent default.
